summary: Actual round-1 original-author revision accepts frozen critic F1: the requested fixed-delta lower bound remains unproved. Retained independently reviewed deductions are the actual tiny-prime product sector o(M_N) relative to expressly imported classical maximal BV at fixed B>=8; the elementary odd squarefree y-rough open central-strip o(M_N) estimate at every fixed B>0; and the separate rough squareful long error. Their exact support identity leaves the original nonrough, even rough, and outer odd residuals, including wheel, atom, endpoints, integer cofactors and k=1. Only a coarse O(N L^5) residual bound is proved. No Goldbach proof, powers-of-two improvement, breakthrough or novelty determination is claimed. The frozen proposal and review are preserved. Token and monetary usage are unknown; no invented usage values are supplied.
